pages.text: $(thing)CTCSS$() is a low tone sent under your voice. A repeater with an access tone only repeats stations sending it. On a handheld press ENTER on the frequency page for the $(thing)Tone$() and $(thing)Offset$() pages; a base station has buttons and knobs for both.$(br2)Example: repeater 146.340 in, 146.940 out: handheld on 146.940, offset -600.
